title: Learning about reptiles
brief_description: Identifies biological characteristics, adaptations and eating habits of turtles, alligators, crocodiles, snakes, lizards and tortoises. Illustrates the versatility of these animals to adapt to environments ranging from harsh deserts to oceans. Suitable for upper primary and lower secondary levels.
